narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Rocket Lab rose every year, because its last bar is the tallest.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Its first two bars are both about six.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Staying the same is not rising, so it did not rise every year.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>First identify the layout and the scale, then infer from the bars.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Rising every year means each bar is taller than the one before.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. An organisation launched four, six and six rockets. Did it rise every year?
